name: Minntz | 1g Preroll | Honey Dew
description: Indulge in a euphoric dreamlike indica crafted for the perfect cozy evening. Rich notes of creamy gas mingle with hints of sweet fruit, delivering a decadent, dessert-inspired flavor profile. The experience begins with a blissful, creative uplift before easing into soothing relaxation and dreamy tranquility.
